question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Bear a grudge

options.text: To consider people with kindness and care
To feel angry against somebody for a past incident
To entertain the guests with utmost happiness
To feel satisfied with the achievements

solution:
The correct answer is: **'To feel angry against somebody for a past incident'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given idiom **"Bear a grudge"** means to harbor persistent feelings of resentment or ill will towards someone due to a past insult or injury. (पुरानी बात पर खुन्नस रखना)

 
 
• **Example:** Even though the argument was years ago, John still bears a grudge against his brother.
 
 
 
• The correct meaning "To feel angry against somebody for a past incident" denotes a sustained feeling of resentment or anger towards someone because of a past offence or harm. (किसी पुरानी घटना के लिए किसी के खिलाफ गुस्सा महसूस करना)

Therefore, the correct answer is- ***To feel angry against somebody for a past incident.***
